headline: PHI @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 4.94 at NYM 4.09, with a projected total of 9.03. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved +0.81 runs while NYM moved +0.18, changing the projected margin by +0.63 runs. The projected total climbed +0.99, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +16.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Alan Rangel has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 2 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bo Bichette, Carson Benge, Trea Turner, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brett Baty because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
